costByHarness: sum by (service_name, model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code|codex.*|github-copilot|copilot-chat|opencode|pi", deployment_environment_name!="test"} | agent_event="api_request" or event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
costBySource: sum by (model, query_source) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$r]))
failing: topk(15, sum by (bash_command) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" | tool_name="Bash" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json bash_command [$r])))
